Anya: Quick heads-up — rerank-v2 int8 bringup shows a sizeable NDCG gap on the long-document slice of websearch-v3.
Anya: Baseline (fp16) ndcg@10 = 0.412, mrr = 0.265
Anya: Int8 build ndcg@10 = 0.378, mrr = 0.243
Anya: Short queries (<=512 tokens) are basically unchanged. Repro on staging yes. Suspect: truncation/windowing mismatch between eval harness and runtime (or kv-cache alignment) — cc @Marina @Ravi :thinking:
Anya: Eval command / snippet below:
```
./eval_harness --model rerank-v2:int8 --dataset websearch-v3 --split dev --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --longdoc-bucket-threshold 2048
# sample output lines:
# NDCG@10: 0.378
# MRR: 0.243
```
Sam: What's the exact definition of "long-doc" here? cutoff >2048 or >4096? how many queries in that bucket?
Anya: Our bucket is >2048 tokens. Counts: dev long-doc bucket = 6700 queries, avg doc len ≈ 5370 tokens, tail (>8000 tokens) ~12% of that bucket. The drop concentrates in >8k token docs.
Marina: Could be alignment/fragmentation issue. Two quick ablations to try: (1) rolling-window scoring with overlap (e.g. window=4096, stride=2048) (2) forced truncate to 2048 then eval. Also try `--disable-prefix-cache` and compare token counts from tokenizer.debug between harness and prod.
Ravi: I'll run ablation (a) and (b) now on staging. ETA ~40m. Scheduling jobs.
EvalBot: Job 92734 started: rerank-eval(websearch-v3 longdocs) ablation a/b — https://ci.internal/jobs/92734
Anya: If rolling-window recovers the gap, it's a formatting/serving mismatch and we should either enable windowed scoring in quantized runtime or enforce consistent truncation in dataset curation. If not, next step is checking attention kernel behavior across seqlen boundaries.
Sam: Also double-check preprocessing: HTML-stripping / whitespace normalization differences between harness and prod — we saw that before and it affected token counts.
Ravi: Results from staging:
- ablation (a) rolling-window 4k/2k => ndcg@10 = 0.407 (delta +0.029 vs int8 baseline), mrr = 0.258
- ablation (b) truncate 2k => ndcg@10 = 0.365 (worse), mrr = 0.238
Ravi: So rolling-window recovers most of the gap.
Anya: Good signal — looks like a scoring windowing issue. I'll file a ticket: RINF-1423 "int8: long-doc scoring mismatch — enable rolling-window scoring or config guardrails" and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for follow-up. Also adding "validate long-doc scoring parity" to model onboarding checklist.
Marina: Add a small long-doc golden to eval harness as a regression test (one doc >10k tokens with known expected ranking metrics).
Sam: I'll add the harness test and a tiny CI job that runs on merges to main :thumbsup:
Anya: Thanks everyone — keep updates in the ticket. If someone wants the raw logs I pushed them to the job link above.
